emma: heads up - saw a sudden jump in unassigned leads right after last night's enrichment tweak. SLA alert fired. anyone on routing? :eyes:
ben: digging in. router traces show enrichment responses often arriving right after rr slot expires so leads fall to unassigned fallback.
rachel: we trimmed enrich TTL to 22s last sprint to cut latency. this reduces margin on backend blips.
hubspot-bot: metric.alert: inbound.handoff.unassigned_rate=5.9% window=12m source=hs-sync service=lead-router
emma: short patch idea: when enrich times out, route to overflow but tag leads pending_enrich and hold from outbound for 30m. also set defer_owner_write=true so SF/HS don't get partial owner writes. keeps SDR cadence clean.
ben: +1. router change small. plan: soft-route to overflow + set metadata.pending_enrich=true + enqueue one retry after 8s. emit metric inbound.handoff.pending_enrich_count.
sam: add a saved HubSpot filter for pending_enrich leads and update SDR playbook to skip those for 30m. also add a dashboard badge so reps see "pending enrich" state.
rachel: canary plan: 5% for 30m. rollback if unassigned_rate > baseline*1.8 or assign_latency_p95 > baseline*2. Config snippet: ```router.handoff = { softfail_overflow: true, pending_enrich_ttl_s: 1800, retry_seconds: 8, defer_owner_write: true, canary_pct: 5 }```
emma: owners: ben -> code + canary, rachel -> deploy guardrails + rollback play, sam -> HS saved views + SDR doc, me -> customer ops comms and update SLA playbook. start canary in 20m.
hubspot-bot: deploy.scheduled: canary=5% scheduled_by=ben start=3654322120
ben: starting canary at scheduled time, will post quick deltas. ping @here if anything spikes.
emma: thanks team. long-term: add enrichment circuit-breaker and monitor DB replica lag so this doesn't recur. :rocket:
